snippet.title: SNOOPY (C64 - FULL GAME)
snippet.description:
Zeus presents Snoopy (un-emulated) for the C64, an odd little game from the golden era of C64 gaming which must not be forgotten alongside the software house and all programmers that were involved in making this game.

Year of release: 1984

Guide Snoopy across the many hazards without dying, that's about it really lol.
Funny but crap at the same time and can be excused for being basic as it's from 1984, there are 20 screens in total and for every loop yu pass the games exceeds in speed to the point it's insane and unplayable but thanks to an invincibility cheat I'm able to show all of the game to the point the game ends on a blank white screen.

I hope all you retro gaming fans enjoy this upload enough to sub and possibly consider donating a small fee via the Paypal icon as this helps me to keep the channel growing.

Please note: NONE of my game uploads are emulated in any way whatsoever, they are 100% original recordings by myself taken directly from the original hardware the game was intended for, that way you know you're watching the real thing.
I will also always state weather i am using any cheats in the game, if not mentioned then i am not using any.
Please check out my channel (http://www.youtube.com/user/ZEUSDAZ/videos), dedicated to gamers who loved the games of yesteryear.

Switch to 480p for best video quality and feel free to leave comments on my channel and vid's.

Keeping the memory of the C64 and it's cool games alive!!!
